title: Conan lock on an older format
description: conan.lock declares a lock `version` from the pre-0.5 format. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a lock `version` from the pre-0.5 format.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a lock `version` from the pre-0.5 format.
limitation: It matches a lock `version` from the pre-0.5 format in the parsed conan.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
